name: cha
description: CHA — Cyclic Hostile Adversarial Harnessing. A release-gate loop for coding agents: hunt, brief a second-eye reviewer on another platform, adjudicate every claim by execution, write the red test first, register a mutant for every fix, and never ship until the gate is green. Battle-tested on a 77k-line zero-dependency CLI: 12,596 tests, 1,179 mutants, 39 gates.
